name: freee 会計
description: Business connector for freee 会計 (accounting) through the freee API with the customer's own freee app. Read-only, always: companies, deals (取引), partners, account items and receipt metadata of the configured companies. There is no write tool because the deals API has no draft state.

clientId.description: Client ID of the freee app (freee app store developer console). The client secret goes in the secret store: connector.freee.clientSecret.

companyIds.description: freee company (事業所) ids the agent may read. Requests for other companies are refused.

redirectPort.description: Loopback port of the callback URL registered on the freee app (http://localhost:<port>/callback).
